decision_rule: every common and option-specific mandatory gate must be PASS with hash-bound evidence; FAIL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EVALUATED or missing evidence blocks selection

common_mandatory_gates.requirement: the authenticated object is the exact closed verifier-result bytes and payload type
all ADR 0024 request, assertion, challenge, credential, epoch, build, policy, time and nonce fields are bound
two independent builders verify signed provenance for pinned source, dependencies, parameters and artifact digest
two administratively independent builds produce the exact same verifier artifact digest
the exact verifier policy/configuration digest is allowlisted and cross-bound to the result
caller nonce and evidence ID are single-use with atomic consumption, bounded time and monotonic revocation epoch
producer and consumer reject the same malformed, oversized and non-canonical corpus
reviewer, credential, recovery, verifier and builder trust domains satisfy the independence contract
compromise, revocation, rotation, rollback prevention and recovery rehearsal are documented and tested
the verifier and consumer graphs have reviewed advisories, licenses and target-platform impact

local_pinned_execution.requirement: result transport is private, peer-authenticated and inaccessible to untrusted local processes
the launched executable, policy and mutable dependency set are measured before result acceptance
a single compromised host cannot satisfy both independent reviewer decisions

dsse_signed_result.requirement: the result key is purpose-limited, unavailable to build jobs and independently administered
consumer-selected root, monotonic epoch and offline revocation are checked before signature use
the signer can sign only results emitted by the allowlisted measured verifier build and policy
key compromise cannot authorize rollback and a rehearsed independent recovery root can advance epoch

tie_rule: no automatic winner; if both options pass, a separate ADR must choose based on smaller independently reviewed trust and runtime surface
